apex_theorems_withdrawn.name: SKEFTHawking.AcousticMetric.hawking_temp_from_surface_gravity
apex_theorems_withdrawn.reason: Statement is `∀ bg h, hawkingTemp h.surfaceGravity = h.surfaceGravity / (2*π)`, a rfl against the definition `hawkingTemp κ := κ / (2*π)`. `SonicHorizon.surfaceGravity` (lean/SKEFTHawking/Basic.lean:82) is a bare structure FIELD carrying only `surfaceGravity_pos`; it is never derived from `bg.velocity` or `bg.soundSpeed`, so the theorem binds no physics to the background and cannot back a universality claim. Same defect and same declaration withdrawn from E1 on 2026-08-15; E1/E2 apex overlap remains zero.
